cases.title: Clarification projection and plan approval
cases.description: Create a short two-step plan to draft and publish a three-sentence release note for independent software teams. The budget is zero and the channel is the product changelog. Do not assume the publication date: ask the owner for that missing decision before producing the plan. Do not perform the publication.
cases.default_answer: Use the supplied two-step scope, record any assumption explicitly, and do not publish anything.

cases.title: Immutable rejection, replan, and approval
cases.description: Create a short two-step plan to draft and review a three-sentence release note for independent software teams, for publication on 2026-09-15 in the product changelog. Include an owner and one measurable review exit criterion. Do not perform the publication.
cases.default_answer: Use the supplied scope and state any remaining assumption explicitly.
